Welcome to Northern Equine Therapy Centre

At Northern Equine Therapy Centre, we’re dedicated to providing specialised care and rehabilitation for horses. Our state-of-the-art facility combines expert knowledge with cutting-edge equipment to support recovery, performance enhancement, and overall well-being for equines.

📌 Services We Offer:
	•	Hydrotherapy in a 12ft deep circular pool
	•	Equine Physiotherapy
	•	Rehabilitation Programmes
	•	Injury Prevention & Recovery
	•	Bespoke Training Plans

🐴 Whether your horse is a competitive athlete or a beloved companion, we tailor our programmes to meet their unique needs, ensuring optimal health and performance.

📍 Located in North Yorkshire, we’re proud to serve equestrians from across the northern region.

💻 Visit our website www.northernanimaltherapycentre.co.uk to learn more.
📞 Contact us at 07745554181 to learn more. 

Don’t forget to subscribe for updates, tips, and insights into equine care and therapy!
